keyboardEvidence.browser: Trusted Chromium Enter events through page.keyboard.press; no option-click fallback
keyboardEvidence.jsdom: Per-control tests explicitly call fireEvent.click(detail: 0) after Enter because jsdom does not synthesize the browser activation; those tests alone do not prove native Enter activation

hydrate.scope: Actual shared component in Chromium with existing Studio CSS; every synthetic dev1001.invalid request is fulfilled from in-memory assets or aborted; no HTTP listener, hosted site, app server, auth, database or network access
hydrate.keyboardActivation: Playwright page.keyboard.press Enter; no option-click fallback

checks: Without JavaScript, all eight server-rendered native controls remain visible and required validation blocks submission
Browser media preference is no-preference; existing Studio CSS is loaded
Server-rendered native controls hydrate to shared Select without mismatches
Visible label click focuses shared trigger without opening native picker
Tab order visits only visible shared controls in the original order
Required blank exists as an empty FormData entry, but browser validation prevents a successful submit and focuses the first invalid trigger
Actual browser End/ArrowDown/Enter skips disabled options and disabled optgroups, then commits Card without an option-click fallback
Successful submission contains exactly one value per enabled control, including the optional blank and external form control
A directly disabled required blank is omitted and does not block a valid submission
Selecting an optional blank with real Home/Enter submits its name with an empty string rather than omitting it
A disabled fieldset omits its ordinary control while its first-legend control stays enabled and submits
Re-selecting a required blank with real Home/Enter again blocks submission and preserves the previous successful payload
Native reset restores uncontrolled defaults and controlled native browser reset behavior
Escape closes popup and restores focus
All five option activations originate from trusted browser Enter key events, with no harness option click
